title: Reduction of cohomology vanishing to finitely generated constant subsheaves
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact topological space whose quasi-compact open subsets form a basis and are closed under pairwise intersection. Let d be a nonnegative integer. For a quasi-compact open inclusion j:U\to X put E_U=j_!\underline{\mathbf Z}_U, using the constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] and extension by zero [lem-sc-topological-extension-by-zero-stalks]. Assume H^p(X,E_U)=0 for all p>d and all such U. Assume also that H^q(X,K)=0 for every q>d and every abelian sheaf K admitting a monomorphism K\to\underline{\mathbf Z}_X and an epimorphism \bigoplus_{i=1}^n E_{U_i}\to K for some finite family of quasi-compact opens U_i (including n=0). Then H^p(X,F)=0 for every abelian sheaf F and every p>d, with cohomology as in [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology].

proof.text: Let S be the disjoint union of the groups F(U) over all quasi-compact opens U. For a finite subset A of S form F_A as the image of the finite coproduct of the maps j_! Z_U to F associated to its sections. Ordered by inclusion, these images form a directed system. Every germ belongs to such an image, since quasi-compact opens form a basis. Thus the directed union is F, as checked on stalks. The filtered-cohomology comparison over the quasi-compact whole space reduces vanishing to the F_A.

For an image generated by n sections, take the image of its first n-1 generators and its quotient. The quotient is generated by the remaining section, hence is a quotient of j_! Z_U for a quasi-compact open U. The long exact cohomology sequence reduces vanishing for n generators to the n-1 case and this one-section quotient. The zero-generator image is zero, whose Ext groups vanish.

For a quotient j_! Z_U to G, let K be its kernel, and write K as the directed union of images K_A of finite coproducts of the same compact-open generators. Exact filtered colimits identify G with the colimit of j_! Z_U/K_A. The map j_! Z_U to Z_X obtained from restriction of the constant sheaf and the extension-by-zero adjunction is monic: its stalk map on U is the identity and outside U its source is zero. Each K_A therefore satisfies the assumed finitely generated constant-subsheaf condition.

For p>d, the long exact sequence for 0 to K_A to j_! Z_U to j_! Z_U/K_A to 0 has zero terms H^p(X,j_! Z_U) and H^{p+1}(X,K_A). The first is the compact-open hypothesis; the second is the assumed subsheaf vanishing, since d<p+1. Its middle quotient cohomology vanishes. Apply the filtered comparison to the quotient stages, the induction on generators, and the initial directed union. This proves vanishing for arbitrary F.
